name: Cloud Compositing & Tone Mapping
aliases: ACES-like Tone Mapping and Gamma Encoding
definition: Blends resolved cloud radiance and transmittance with sky and ground backgrounds, applies ACES tone mapping, and converts to sRGB gamma.
summary: Cloud Compositing & Tone Mapping blends volumetric clouds with procedurally generated sky and ground backgrounds, then applies ACES-like tone mapping to produce a display-ready image.
